title: Tales of the Bizarre: 2001 Autumn Special
original_title: Yo nimo Kimyou na Monogatari: 2001 Autumn Special
overview: 5 stories hosted by Tamori: Drama Marathon Synopsis: A woman finds herself trapped in a surreal reality where she must continuously run a marathon under the rules of a television drama production. Kiseki no Onna (Miracle Woman) Synopsis: A woman discovers she possesses an extraordinary and inexplicable ability that completely alters her perception of reality and destiny. Heisoku Kan (Locked Out) Synopsis: A psychological thriller focusing on individuals trapped in a confined space, testing their limits and trust as tension rises. Shinzatou (Heart Sugar) Synopsis: A dark, satirical look at human relationships and obsessions through a surreal premise involving emotions and physical sweet substances. Mama Shinhatsubai! (MaM In Store Now!) Synopsis: A colorful, bizarre comedy-satire where a young woman shops for a new commercialized "mother" character in a supermarket-style store.
